info.name: Pharmacy Mobile App API
info.description:
All endpoints from routes/api.php.

1. Set `base_url` (and `email` / `password`).
2. Run **Auth → Login**: the token is saved to `token` automatically.
3. Every other request uses Bearer `{{token}}` from the collection auth; public ones are set to No Auth.

`lang` sets the Accept-Language header (ar / en).

request.description: Creates the account and emails a 6-digit OTP. `confirm_password` must match `password`.
Returns `token` + `user`. The test script stores the token in the `token` collection variable, which every authenticated request uses.
Resets the password and revokes all existing tokens.
`current_password` is required when PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CURRENT=true, otherwise optional (still checked if sent).

item.description: Served at `/api/v1/user/...`. The same routes also answer at `/api/v1/v1/user/...` for older apps. Language follows the `Accept-Language` header (ar / en).
